notes.title: [Update record for June 29, 2023]
notes.content:
New illustrations published in 2021-2022 have been added to the "TAISHO x ALICE Digital Artbook"!
This brings the total number of pages from 174 to 185.
In addition, 11 wallpapers for PCs and 2 wallpapers for smartphones have been added.
(*Customers who have already purchased "TAISHO x ALICE Digital Artbook" should update their copy.)

notes.title: [Update record for February 15, 2023]
notes.content:
Fixed a problem dependent on user environment.
The program has been enhanced again to address an issue where achievements may not be unlocked in some user environments.

notes.title: [Update record for October 28, 2022]
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!
4 wallpapers for PC and 22 wallpapers for smartphones have been added to "TAISHO x ALICE Digital Artbook"!
Please use it!
